title: Projected Demand for Childminding Services over Three-year Pilot Period
what_it_is: Projected Demand for Childminding Services over Three-year Pilot Period

sections.label: Childminding Pilot for Infants
sections.summary: ECDA launched a three-year Childminding Pilot in December 2024 for infants aged two to 18 months, supporting around 50 infants so far.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Social and Family Development (Mr Goh Pei Ming) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: The Early Childhood Development Agency (ECDA) launched a three-year Childminding Pilot for Infants in December 2024 to grow childminding services for infants aged two to 18 months as an additional caregiving option for parents.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Social and Family Development (Mr Goh Pei Ming) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: Since its launch, the pilot has supported around 50 infants across both childminders' homes and community premises.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Social and Family Development (Mr Goh Pei Ming) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: Parents who have enrolled have shared positive feedback on the dedicated care their infants receive and the convenience, especially since childminders are able to accommodate the parents' caregiving preferences and normally, they are also close by, proximity wise.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Social and Family Development (Mr Goh Pei Ming) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: We are also encouraged by the growing interest in the pilot, with around 160 families indicating interest to enrol in the next six months and these include infants who are yet to be born.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Social and Family Development (Mr Goh Pei Ming) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: As the pilot progresses, ECDA will continue to study demand for the pilot and work with operators to meet demand from parents and enhance service delivery.

sections.label: Pilot Numbers and Awareness
sections.summary: The speaker says 50 infants is a good start, is prepared for higher numbers, and is working on public awareness.

sentences.speaker: Mr Goh Pei Ming
sentences.text: For the numbers, we are assured that 50 infants is a good start.

sentences.speaker: Mr Goh Pei Ming
sentences.text: Whether the number can be higher, yes, we are prepared for the number to be higher.

sentences.speaker: Mr Goh Pei Ming
sentences.text: Primarily, I think it may be a function of also public awareness that this option exists and that is something that we are working on, to enhance public awareness of this option.

sentences.speaker: Mr Goh Pei Ming
sentences.text: Whether we are exploring extending this pilot, I think we are still in the early days and we are refining it along the way with operators, with feedback from parents, and we will stay open.
